title.zh: 入射中性边界通量归一化

summary: Scale a caller-owned H or H2 boundary shape distribution on the positive axial-velocity half space to a requested incoming neutral particle flux, returning the scaled boundary distribution, the applied scale, and the pre-scale flux integral.

identity.relation: the saved positive-half flux normalization: incoming_flux = Vth * sum(volume * shape * vx) over vx > 0; scale = abs(target_flux) / incoming_flux
identity.direction: boundary shape plus axes, volume, thermal speed and target flux -> scaled boundary, scale, incoming flux
identity.definition: Only the positive-vx half enters the integral; the returned distribution is exactly zero on the nonpositive half; the scale is the saved abs(target)/flux form, so a negative requested flux yields the same positive scale
identity.model: the saved formal implementation's boundary source normalization
identity.geometry: one radial dimension times the axial velocity axis
identity.coordinates: shape and volume in the source's normalized units, vx in normalized axial speed, thermal speed m/s, target flux m^-2 s^-1
identity.boundary: finite nonnegative (nvr,nvx) shape with (nvr,nvx) volume, positive thermal speed, finite target flux, at least one positive vx node, strictly positive positive-half flux
assumptions: The caller owns the boundary shape and the quadrature; this asset normalizes, it does not construct a distribution.
The sign convention of the requested flux is the caller's (the saved scale uses abs); direction is carried by the profile, not the scale.

inputs.name: boundary_shape
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; axial velocity on the second axis.

inputs.name: vx
inputs.constraints: Finite; must contain at least one positive node.

inputs.name: cylindrical_volume
inputs.constraints: Finite, same shape as the boundary shape.

inputs.name: target_flux_m2_s
inputs.constraints: Finite (any sign; the saved scale uses the absolute value).

outputs.name: incoming_boundary
outputs.constraints: Zero on the nonpositive-vx half; the scaled shape on the positive half.

preconditions: Finite nonnegative shape and volume, positive thermal speed, a positive-vx half with positive flux.
supported: Boundary sources for H and H2 inflow conditions on a shared normalized mesh.
excluded: Shapes with nonpositive flux on the positive half; meshes without a positive-vx node; non-finite scalars.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when the shape/quadrature/scalar contract is violated, vx has no positive node, or the positive-half flux is nonpositive.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError when the evaluation produces a non-finite result where the contract demands finiteness; no fallback is selected.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no result.

example.description: Normalize one boundary shape to a requested flux and confirm the positive-half semantics and rejections.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import normalize_incoming_neutral_boundary
shape = np.ones((2, 3))
volume = np.ones((2, 3))
vx = np.array([-1.0, 0.5, 1.0])
result, scale, initial = normalize_incoming_neutral_boundary(shape, vx, volume, 2.0, -12.0)
assert initial == 6.0 and scale == 2.0
assert np.all(result[:, 0] == 0.0)
try:
    normalize_incoming_neutral_boundary(shape, np.array([-1.0, -0.5, 0.0]), volume, 2.0, 12.0)
except ValueError as error:
    assert 'positive incoming half' in str(error)
else:
    raise AssertionError('a mesh without a positive-vx node must be rejected')
example.expected: The positive half scaled to the requested flux (sign-independent scale), the negative half exactly zero; a mesh without an incoming half is rejected.

scope: That the returned flux integral after scaling equals the requested target on the positive half.
That the negative half is exactly zero and the scale matches the saved abs(target)/flux form.
The fail-closed contracts (no positive half, zero flux, invalid scalars).
